english.note: Use this formal business or written term when referring to customers or clients collectively or professionally.

exampleSentences.english: The company regularly collects customer feedback.
exampleSentences.traditional: 公司會定期收集顧客意見。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gung1 si1 wui5 ding6 kei4 sau1 zaap6 gu3 haak3 ji3 gin3

english.note: Use this for a customer or buyer when the focus is on purchasing goods or services rather than receiving professional advice.

exampleSentences.english: This client wants to buy this computer.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢位顧客想買呢部電腦。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 wai2 gu3 haak3 soeng2 maai5 ni1 bou6 din6 nou5

english.note: Use this when focusing on the hotel guest as a customer or patron rather than as someone staying there.

exampleSentences.english: The hotel must protect the rights of every guest.
exampleSentences.traditional: 酒店必須保障每位顧客嘅權益。
exampleSentences.jyutping: zau2 dim3 bit1 seoi1 bou2 zoeng3 mui5 wai2 gu3 haak3 ge3 kyun4 jik1
